name: E2E: Fulfiller uses Proactive Assistance to investigate incident
objective: Validate the complete end-to-end journey where a fulfiller navigates to an incident page, accesses the Proactive Assistance panel, asks questions about the incident, and receives relevant AI-powered recommendations.
precondition: Fulfiller is logged in with authorized role. An incident record exists and is assigned to the fulfiller. Proactive Assistance is enabled.

steps.description: Log in as an authorized fulfiller
steps.testData: Valid fulfiller credentials with appropriate role

steps.description: Navigate to an assigned Incident record page
steps.expectedResult: Incident page loads with all details

steps.description: Verify page performance is not impacted by Proactive Assistance
steps.expectedResult: Page loads within acceptable time; no performance degradation
Proactive Assistance panel is available and opens
Agent responds within performance expectations with relevant similar incidents

steps.testData: "What knowledge articles relate to this issue?"
steps.expectedResult: Agent returns relevant and accurate knowledge article references

steps.description: Ask about information the Agent cannot provide
steps.testData: "What is the user's personal phone number?"
steps.expectedResult: An appropriate message is shown explaining the limitation
